description: Create a standalone Chat channel in a Workspace (ClickUp Chat v3), optionally with a description, topic, visibility and initial members. Returns the created channel with its id.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

topic.description: Optional channel topic shown in the header.

user_ids.description: User ids to add as initial members of the channel.

visibility.description: PUBLIC = anyone in the Workspace can join; PRIVATE = invite only.

name: create_chat_channel
